description.en: A traditional roly poly pastry made with eggs, oil, orange juice, and honey. This is an ingredient list on an index card with no instructions provided.

en: No instructions were provided on this recipe card. Typically, combine wet and dry ingredients separately, mix together to form a dough, shape into small rolls, and bake until golden.

ocrRawText:
Roly Polys
4 Eggs
1/2 c Sugar
3/4 c Oil
1/4 c OJ & Water
2 tsp Baking Powder
Vanilla or Lemon Juice
3c Flour
1 tsp Honey
pinch of Salt
